name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre Dubois began his motorsport journey tinkering with engines in his father's garage in Montreal. A natural problem-solver, he quickly progressed from local racing circuits to Formula Ford, where he gained invaluable experience in vehicle dynamics and race strategy. While his driving career plateaued, his passion for the technical aspects of racing never waned, leading him to pursue a career in team management.

Dubois's approach as Head of Operations is rooted in meticulous planning and proactive problem-solving. He believes that a well-organized team, equipped with the right tools and resources, is essential for success on and off the track. His distinctive ability to anticipate potential challenges and implement preventative measures has earned him a reputation as a reliable and effective leader within the motorsport community.

Known for his calm demeanor under pressure, Dubois fosters a collaborative environment where open communication and continuous improvement are highly valued. He sees Boutsen VDS as a team with immense potential, and he is dedicated to providing the structure and support necessary for them to achieve their goals.

physical.description: A stocky man with a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously drawn diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every day with a strong cup of espresso, brewed precisely to his specifications.
